title: Filter-induced linear topologies on residuated lattices: Hausdorffness, profiniteness, and finiteness conditions
summary: We study linear topologies on residuated lattices generated by systems of filters, with emphasis on the uniform structures and separation properties that they determine. A down-directed family of filters gives a natural compatible uniformity, and the associated topology makes the residuated lattice into a topological algebra. We characterize Hausdorffness by the triviality of the intersection of the underlying filter system.
